notes.page_content: The continuation proposes assuming that X is locally homotopically trivial, says the Artin–Mazur pro-simplicial object is then essentially constant in the ordinary homotopy category, contrasts an étale topos of a scheme, and proposes a pro-n-groupoid together with an ind-n-category whose ind-structure corresponds to local triviality over finer covers. A new paragraph acknowledges the correspondent’s resistance to retaining only the homotopy type and begins an unfinished statement of conviction.
